source_evidence: Exact player 'Lets take and preserve what evidence we can, and the coffers for valuation and mara' authorizes taking recoverable evidence and the historic coffer into Mara's care for preservation and valuation, not sale, spending, conversion to spendable currency or unilateral adjudication of title. Day331~18:15–18:35 at western Ossent service house. Mara and Cirren carefully document and pad the two original incised metal record leaves and their lidded ceramic container, with existing ordinary packing supplies, no new purchased materials or expense. Engraved bronze/stone route instrument and in-place architectural dedication and charter remain undisturbed at site because physical preservation is preferable; their measurements/working copies already made. Both provisional warders willingly consent to release portable documents and coffer for documented safekeeping/valuation; Hessa and her husband are informed and consent to the temporary custody arrangement without relinquishing any resident/property/salvage rights or purporting to authorize title on Crown's behalf. Cirren records the transfer and leaves a duplicate signed item-description/custody note with warders. Mara accepts physical custody aboard party coach of (1) two original incised metal record leaves, (2) original lidded ceramic container, (3) one historic travel coffer and its original contents: old coins previously estimated at180gp recoverable metal-equivalent and nonmagical keepsakes, exact count/denominations/provenance and professional collectible valuation pending. There is ONE known coffer, not newly duplicated. Keep whole assemblage together and separately from V's ordinary purse. Mara holds authenticated survey and copies; Cirren retains working records. No item sold, melted, spent, assigned personal/estate value or entered as spendable currency; no donation, permanent transfer of title, legal clearance or final salvage division. No additional dice because ordinary safe packing, willing documented custodial handover and routine carrying, no disputed coercive request or contested valuation undertaken. V/Fenar/Cirren return to near-bank surface/coach with Mara; Rhevan/Ossric remain provisional guardians, each pair of skeletons posted. Time~18:35. All party resources unchanged. V chooses next action.
